title: F1 Manager 2024
provenance: Reported by bethstibbles (highball#234, 2026-10-01), Apple M1, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.35, the Epic copy. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Installed through Highball's Epic support with the Visual C++ runtimes, then crashed at the copyright screen, where the game starts its intro video, without writing a log of its own. Just before the crash the graphics layer printed 'Invalid device handle' for a shared texture, the failure engines before r13 had when a game and its video player share a texture. Engines since r13 no longer fail that texture. Whether that was the whole crash was not measured, and the reporter did not test again.

knownIssues.symptom: Crash at the copyright screen (reported on an M1, macOS 26.6.2, engine of Highball 0.9.35)
knownIssues.cause: likely the shared texture between the game and its intro video, which engines before r13 failed to open
knownIssues.fix: update Highball, engines r13 and later open that texture. Not confirmed on this game
